activities.caption: pair the machinery with its clinical fact
activities.name: clinCaseMatch

config.prompt: Schizophrenia's clinical machinery — pair each piece with its fact:

pairs.right: block dopamine D2 receptors — enough for most patients, but about a third prove treatment-resistant
the standard after two failed antipsychotic trials, with blood monitoring required because it can crush white-cell production
predicts worse prognosis — which turns early detection into policy
guardrail on detention for assessment and community treatment orders, alongside capacity assessment and second opinions

config.why: Because insight itself is often part of the illness, the law builds coercion tools — and their misuse, the Soviet Union's psychiatric abuse of dissidents, is why international safeguards exist at all.

activities.caption: find the faulty line — a label briefing
activities.name: clinSplitSpot

config.prompt: One line of this label briefing is wrong — click it:
lines: 'Schizophrenia' translates as 'split mind' — a historical description of fragmented thought.
Jekyll-and-Hyde switching is dissociative identity disorder, a different diagnosis entirely.
The confusion is so damaging that Japan officially renamed the disorder in 2002.
The word confirms what the public assumes: sufferers switch between two personalities.
config.correction: The term means 'split mind', not split personality — the fragmented-thought description, not Jekyll-and-Hyde switching.
config.why: The 2002 renaming to 'integration disorder' was chosen precisely to escape the confusion.

activities.anchor: smoke at roughly two to three times
activities.caption: place the mortality gap
activities.name: clinMortalityPlace

config.prompt: People with schizophrenia die on average how many years earlier than the general population? Place the marker:
config.why: 15–20 years earlier — mostly cardiovascular and respiratory disease, not suicide: antipsychotic metabolic side effects (weight gain, diabetes risk) plus a health system that fails to deliver routine physical care. The mortality gap is now treated as a quality-of-care indicator.

activities.anchor: The bipolar trap is the measurement lesson's sharpest edge
activities.caption: order the measurement loop
activities.name: clinMeasureOrder

config.prompt: Measurement-based care, end to end — order the loop:
items: Administer the PHQ-9: nine items, scored 0–27, cut-off 10, sensitivity and specificity near 88%
Re-administer it every session as outcome tracking, not just diagnosis
The feedback system flags stagnation weeks earlier than clinical impression
In Lambert's randomised trials, improvement roughly doubles among deteriorating patients
config.why: A rating scale you can administer in two minutes that doubles as outcome tracking — measurement is machinery, not ritual, and it catches what confident impressions miss.

activities.anchor: they are either exact cures or pure fraud
activities.caption: bet on the meta-analysis
activities.name: clinAntidepPredict

config.q: Cipriani and colleagues (2018) covered 21 drugs and over 100,000 patients in double-blind trials. What did it find?
choices: No antidepressant beat placebo once the serotonin-deficiency story collapsed
Every antidepressant was more effective than placebo — modestly, with effects strongest for severe depression
All antidepressants beat placebo by large margins at every severity
config.why: 'The mechanism is not what we thought' and 'the treatment works better than nothing' are both true — the retired serotonin-deficiency story and the placebo-beating meta-analysis are compatible; confusing them is how this debate stays loud.

activities.anchor: moved in DSM-5 into the addiction family
activities.caption: file the treatment blend by mechanism
activities.name: clinGamblingBuckets

config.prompt: Gambling disorder's treatment blend — file each element by its mechanism:

items.label: naltrexone, an opioid antagonist, reducing gambling urges
reading craving as dopamine circuitry, not moral weakness
CBT aimed at the gambler's fallacy — the belief that a machine is 'due'
a family member taking control of the accounts
financial safeguards as environmental ethics in treatment
craving, tolerance and continuing despite harm — minus the substance

config.why: Moved into the addiction family in DSM-5 for exactly these shared mechanisms — and because these patients are competent, therapy is consent-based throughout: clinical influence is persuasion plus structure, never compulsion.

activities.anchor: Anxiety disorders are the most prevalent psychiatric conditions
activities.caption: call Öst's response rate
activities.name: clinExposureEstimate

config.prompt: In Öst's trials, roughly what share of specific-phobia cases responded to a single session of exposure therapy?
config.why: About 90% for one three-hour session — an effect size almost no other intervention in medicine matches. The mechanism is inhibitory learning, not habituation theatre: planned, graded confrontations that let the feared outcome fail to occur and new safety learning consolidate (Craske's model).
config.context: Measurement runs alongside: the GAD-7 detects generalised anxiety at a cut-off of 10, sensitivity near 89%.

activities.name: clinRosenhanTimeline

events.title: Rosenhan's pseudopatients
events.text: Eight people with no diagnosis admitted to psychiatric hospitals after claiming to hear voices; normal behaviour inside was pathologised — labels overwhelmed trained staff's perceptions.

events.title: Tarasoff v. Regents
events.text: California establishes the duty to protect identifiable third parties from a threatening patient — breaching confidence to save a life.

events.title: DSM-III
events.text: Structured interviews and operational criteria — the field's response to the reliability crisis the study made undeniable.

events.title: The Great Pretender
events.text: Cahalan finds Rosenhan's own records thinner than claimed — landmark studies need the same scrutiny they deliver.
